user_confirmed_rules.overtime_rounding: Exact calculation without rounding (rawMinutes and hours decimal), manual rounding modal on Overtime Table for HR
user_confirmed_rules.early_checkin_ot: Check-in between 06:00 and 06:30 for 07:30 shift is counted as early overtime with isEarlyIn flag; check-in after 06:30 does not receive early OT
user_confirmed_rules.sunday_rule: Sunday shifts are not marked as regular 'W' workdays on timesheets; full hours converted to Sunday OT with 30m lunch deduction if >= 8h; missing punches still flagged as MCI/MCO
user_confirmed_rules.rest_rule_12h: Option A: 12-hour rest rule evaluated on actual checkOut to checkIn (or shift hours if punch missing), flagged on shiftRosters
user_confirmed_rules.timesheet_cycle_separation: Method 1: Two independent views (Official 21-20 and Seasonal 01-31). 'ALL' mode removed. Automatic cleanup of old dailyTimesheets, overtimeRecords, and rawAttendanceLogs upon importing a new timesheet file. Dedicated Clear Timesheet Data button.
user_confirmed_rules.excel_date_parsing: cellDates: false in SheetJS + parseExcelDate with SSF parse_date_code and +12h safety buffer to avoid historical Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh 30s epoch skew. parseExcelTime for decimal fractions of day. Dynamic column header mapping.
user_confirmed_rules.annual_leave_quota: Fully flexible: configurable upon creation and editable by HR Manager role
user_confirmed_rules.diligence_reduction_rules: Default applies company-wide, but fully customizable per department or employee class module
user_confirmed_rules.diligence_off_ul_aggregation: Off (unexcused) and UL (unpaid approved leave) aggregated: >= 2 days deducts 50%, >= 3 days = 0đ. Other leave types (AL, SL, PL, PH, ML, BT) do not deduct
user_confirmed_rules.group_2_productivity_bonus: Formula: (actualWD + annualLeaveAL) * 1,000,000 / standardWD. Probation = 0đ. UL/Off deduction rules applied. Configurable in Settings.
user_confirmed_rules.trade_union_fee: Dynamic configuration in SettingsPage and per-employee customAllowances, default 40,000đ
